content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to use [product_name] in my project, but I cannot find information on how to connect it with Wonderware InTouch. If I use [product_name] with an Ethernet port, is it possible to exchange data between [product_name] and my SCADA system through DASSIDirect, or do I need to use an OPC server? Or is there an alternative? Thank you in advance for any responses.
[product_name] [article_no] utilizes the S7-200 protocol for communication. Does Wonderware support this protocol?
Yes, to connect S7-200 controllers to Wonderware, I use the dassidirect driver, so it should work similarly for [product_name]. Thank you for your helpful reply.
Were you able to get this working? I am currently trying to connect Intouch with [product_name] using the DASSIDirect driver, but am having trouble making it work.

Same situation here. Has anyone successfully connected [product_name] [article_no] with Intouch using DASSIDirect? I am still trying to figure out how to configure [product_name] for this type of communication (there isn't much to set up in Intouch). For example, what is the correct TSAP setting for [product_name], and how should it be configured? What syntax should be used for [product_name]? How can I access I8 in SMC? Is there any special setup required in [product_name] for this communication? Are all memory areas accessible (VM, I/O, markers, timers, etc) in [product_name]?
Consider checking out this video on YouTube: [url] It might provide some assistance.

Hello, thank you for your support. Unfortunately, the example in the video uses KEPServer, not DASSIDirect. I’d like to know if anyone has managed to establish communication between [product_name] and Wonderware using DASSIDirect, since I have already installed and am using the DASSIDirect server for other tasks. Thank you.

Hi, It is possible to read a network input or output from [product_name]. You will need the DASSIDirect server. In the [product_name] software, add an S7 client connection—just enter the IP address of the Wonderware PC and a remote TSAP. In the DASSIDirect configuration, add a S7CP_200 object and specify both local and remote TSAPs as required, along with the device group. After that, you can read a network output from [product_name] using a tag named "VX0.0".
